segments_b.text: You won't need your weapons here lay your weapons down and come join us. I am Negan guardian of the 12 protector of the 13
I was made for war. I know the weight of what you're carrying because I carried it
You can lay it down here. No one here will hurt you for arriving unarmed long. Have I kept this threshold?
Then I lay down my solitude with my sword and I lay down my war beside it take my hand loner
Then let us face whatever comes together
